description: This file defines a React custom hook called useInterval, which provides a declarative way to set up interval timers that update with the latest callback. It allows starting and stopping the interval, with optional automatic start based on the autoStart parameter.

methods.name: useInterval(callback, delay, autoStart = false)
methods.description: A React hook that manages a setInterval timer, updating the callback reference to always use the latest callback and providing start and stop controls. Supports auto-start.

ctags.name: useInterval
ctags.pattern: /^export default function useInterval(callback, delay, autoStart = false) {$/
